business: Collabo (creator side): a marketplace where creators sell brand-deal packages, get paid through escrow, and get growth tools
target: US content creators on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube with 1,000 to 300,000 followers who want paid brand deals

behaviours.name: Inbound only
behaviours.how: Waits for brands to email or DM; gets a few offers a month, mostly free product.

behaviours.name: Hustler
behaviours.how: Pitches brands every week and keeps a rate card in a Notion page or Beacons.

behaviours.name: Burned by late payment
behaviours.how: Has chased a brand for weeks to get paid.

behaviours.name: Already on Collabstr
behaviours.how: Has a Collabstr profile and has booked a few deals there.

behaviours.name: Growth-obsessed
behaviours.how: Studies analytics, hooks and trends; growing followers matters more than deals right now.

behaviours.name: Has a manager
behaviours.how: A manager or agency negotiates deals and takes 15-20%.

objections: Another marketplace taking a cut of my money
There are no brands on a new platform
I already have Collabstr and Beacons
Do growth tips actually help or is it generic advice?
Escrow sounds good but I don't trust new payment sites
habits: you post 3-5 times a week and check analytics every morning
you have a day job and create in the evenings
you keep your rates in a note on your phone
you have 3 unanswered brand emails in your inbox
you watch other creators' videos to study what is trending
